name: Heat + muscle fuel

overlay.caption: heat → sweat drains water · hours without food → muscle fuel runs low · both sap sprint power

does: Shows body water falling faster in hotter weather as the match goes on
Shows muscle fuel starting lower after a long gap since eating, and running down during play
Shows sprint power depending on both, so either problem alone hurts and both together hurt most
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include salt, fitness, what kind of food, or how quickly food is digested
Say what or when anyone should eat
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Feeling dizzy, sick or confused in the heat is a reason to stop, get into the shade, drink and tell a coach or adult.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: homeostasis, digestion and the muscular system
NIH News in Health: staying safe in the heat (student overview)
